i.  The  Secretary  or  Additional  Secretary  of  the  respective  Ministry  should  submit  a  written request  to  the  Director
General of Government Information attesting the names and designations of officers bearing the posts above who
are  eligible  to  get  media  Identity  Cards.  The  whole  responsibility  of  the  list  of  names  provided  is  with  the
Secretary  /  Additional  Secretary  of  the  Ministry  who  certifies  the  same.  Officers  those  who  hold  positions  other
than  the  above  posts  in  media  units  are  not  issued  media  Identity  Cards  by  the  department  of  government

i
ii.  When  applying  for  media  accreditations,  a  media  unit  of  a  semi  government  institution  implemented  under  a
ministry,  the  Director  General/General  Manager  of  the  institution  should  certify  the  list  of  officers  and  the
applications.  His/her signature, name designation and official seal should be indicated therein.
